name: bracemark-share
description: The native halves the bracemark-expo share sheet needs, one per host (docs/share-sheet.md). Android: the translucent ShareActivity hosting the RN share sheet, plus the BracemarkShare close() module. iOS: BracemarkShareKeyboard, a native view that reports how much of itself the keyboard covers inside the share extension, where RN's own keyboard frames come through RCTKeyWindow() as zero and an iPad's form sheet moves without JS seeing it. Also iOS: BracemarkShareSwipeGuard, which asks the share extension's view controller to hold the host sheet's swipe-to-dismiss off while the list and tag pickers are up. Local Expo module, autolinked from apps/bracemark-expo/modules into both the app and the extension target.
